lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Are you sure this is the right way?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You've been saying that for the past twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Unless you've got a better idea.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.caption: [Wings erupt from the trees. The woman cries out.]

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Come on. Let's get out of here.
